title: Structural Insights into The Role of MAGEA4 in RAD18 Regulation: Implications for Ubiquitin Ligase-Binding across the MAGE Protein Family
authors: Simonne Griffith-Jones; Lucía Álvarez; Urbi Mukhopadhyay; Sarah Gharbi; Mandy Rettel; Michael Adams; Janosch Hennig; Sagar Bhogaraju
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MAGEA4与RAD18的蛋白-蛋白相互作用及泛素化调控，虽用AlphaFold2建模，但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Melanoma associated antigen 4 (MAGEA4) is a cancer-testis antigen (CTA) that is primarily expressed in the testes of healthy adults but is aberrantly overexpressed and also a poor prognostic marker in several human cancers. In its cancer-specific role, MAGEA4 interacts with RAD18 and activates trans-lesion DNA synthesis (TLS), potentially favouring tumour evolution. However, the precise mode of interaction between RAD18 and MAGEA4 and its implications on the ubiquitination activity of RAD18 are unknown. Here, we employed NMR and AlphaFold2 (AF) to reveal that the ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme RAD6-binding domain (R6BD) of RAD18 interacts with a groove in the C-terminal winged-helix subdomain (WH) of MAGEA4. Using cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS), we found that MAGEA4 displaces RAD6 from the R6BD of RAD18 and inhibits degradative autoubiquitination of RAD18, which could be countered by a competing short peptide of the RAD18 R6B region. AF and XL-MS also revealed an evolutionary invariant intramolecular interaction within RAD18 between the catalytic RING and the DNA-binding SAP domains that is essential for the ubiquitination of PCNA. Using interaction proteomics, we revealed that another Type-I MAGE, MAGE-C2, interacts with the RING ubiquitin ligase TRIM28 in a similar fashion as the MAGEA4/RAD18 complex. We propose that the peptide-binding groove identified in the C-terminal WH of MAGEA4 exists in other type-I MAGE proteins and serves as a ligase-binding cleft. Our data reveal crucial insights into RAD18-mediated ubiquitination of PCNA and its regulation by MAGE-A4.
abstract_zh: 黑色素瘤相关抗原4（MAGEA4）是一种癌-睾丸抗原（CTA），在健康成人的睾丸中主要表达，但在多种人类癌症中异常过表达，并且是预后不良的标志物。在其癌症特异性作用中，MAGEA4与RAD18相互作用并激活跨损伤DNA合成（TLS），可能促进肿瘤演化。然而，RAD18与MAGEA4之间精确的相互作用模式及其对RAD18泛素化活性的影响尚不清楚。在此，我们采用核磁共振（NMR）和AlphaFold2（AF）揭示，RAD18的泛素结合酶RAD6结合域（R6BD）与MAGEA4 C端 winged-helix 亚结构域（WH）中的一个沟槽相互作用。通过交联质谱（XL-MS），我们发现MAGEA4将RAD6从RAD18的R6BD中置换出来，并抑制RAD18的降解性自身泛素化，这一过程可被RAD18 R6B区域的竞争性短肽所抵消。AF和XL-MS还揭示了RAD18内催化RING域与DNA结合SAP域之间一个进化上不变的分子内相互作用，该相互作用对PCNA的泛素化至关重要。通过相互作用蛋白质组学，我们揭示了另一种I型MAGE蛋白MAGE-C2以类似于MAGEA4/RAD18复合物的方式与RING泛素连接酶TRIM28相互作用。我们提出，在MAGEA4 C端WH中鉴定的肽结合沟槽也存在于其他I型MAGE蛋白中，并作为连接酶结合裂隙。我们的数据为RAD18介导的PCNA泛素化及其受MAGE-A4调控提供了关键见解。
